findings.audit_item: Full Regression Test Count (Day 13 vs. Final)
findings.analysis: **Discrepancy:** The "Day 13 Final Verdict" section in both Korean and Japanese evidence cites a full regression of **83 PASS** (DB `kintai_full_test_9f4b67f66b64`). However, the "Final Residual Verification" section, Handoff, and Checklist cite the final full regression as **92 PASS** (DB `kintai_full_test_d4124a317ed0`). While chronologically consistent (83 was an earlier run, 92 is the final), the "Day 13 Final Verdict" header in the evidence files is misleading if it implies the 83-count is the ultimate final state for the project closure, whereas the RTM/Handoff treats 92 as the definitive final regression. Clarification is recommended to distinguish "Day 13 Snapshot" from "Final Project Regression".
